what: Several vertical strips of different colors stand folded on the right (default 5.75rem) — pressing a strip’s handle (vertical text) unfolds only that strip in 1.4s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1) and folds the others. Inside the opened strip the marquee title drops in .4s late (opacity .6s · position .9s, -120% → -160%), and the photo, text and list lines float up from 10% below .5·.56·.62·.65·.67·.68s late. Hovering over a folded strip’s handle widens it by 1rem more. Pressing inside the opened strip or outside the panel folds it (as in the original). Below 992px the strips stack vertically and all stand open.

options.delays: Rising child (data-fx-part=rise) per-item delay in seconds, comma list, default .5,.56,.62,.65,.67,.68 — the last value is reused if the list is short
options.first: ”none” means no band is opened at first, default opens the first band
options.inside: If ‹keep›, clicking inside the expanded band does not fold it (the original folds it)
options.[data-fx-part=strip]: One band — the user paints the background color
options.[data-fx-part=marquee]: Title line that drops from the top when expanding (to make it flow inside, attach the marquee part as well)
options.[data-fx-part=rise]: Photos, text and lines that rise in sequence on unfold

note: The expanded strip takes 100% of the list width and the collapsed strips attach to its right, so the list overflows to the left (like the original, pin the list to the right and set the expanded width with max-width).
